PhD in Computer Science
Earn a PhD in Computer Science with Tracks in AI, Privacy, and Security
Degree: Doctor of Philosophy
Major: Computer Science
Computer science forms the underpinning of most modern industries and even society. Our program helps you develop highly valued skills and the ability to solve problems within a broad range of fields. We aim to provide an environment of scholarship and professional participation to help students build confidence and the ability to interact with colleagues globally.
Our PhD in Computer Science is a 54-credit-hour program allowing you to hone your expertise in algorithms, data science, AI, privacy and security, and more. We prepare you to achieve greater goals and become a leader in computer science.
Through this PhD program, you will be able to strengthen and demonstrate your talent through independent research.
Incoming students may be supported by research assistantships, teaching assistantships, and competitive fellowships to help them achieve their educational and research goals.
Degree FAQs
How long will it take me to complete my PhD?
Typically, students take four to five years to complete their degree. If you come into the program directly from an undergraduate program, you can expect to invest about five years working on your PhD. If you enter the program with a master’s degree, you can complete your PhD in four years.
How do I apply?
Engineering graduate degrees are administered by the university's School of Graduate Studies. Visit them online to apply and learn more about admissions requirements, deadlines and more.
The GRE is required.
What are my degree requirements?
Review the university's General Bulletin for specific course requirements.
